CustomField.description: Where the finding came from, and the only thing that distinguishes the two flows now that they share this object: Session = logged ad-hoc (Exploratory_Session__c / Source_Note__c populated), Test case = raised against a scripted step (Test_Step_Result__c / Test_Execution__c populated). Stamped server-side by UatRunController.saveFinding, never chosen by a tester. This is the triage filter.
